# Three splits: money coming back from the supplier, against two splits
# booked straight to the payable. `Assets:Bank:USD` +100.00 against
# `Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD` −60.00 and −40.00.
#
# Both payable splits are loose — in no lot, settling nothing. They are the
# wrong way round for a payment: a bill's posting puts −100.00 on the
# payable, so its settlement puts +100.00 there.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, none of the splits in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-03-24 * "Supplier refunded the company"

	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD -60.00 USD
		guid: "3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD -40.00 USD
